annotations.title: Receipts Index: paid endpoints and prices

description: Reads GET /.well-known/x402 (and /v1/manifest for the price text) on the Receipts API and returns the paid endpoints with their prices in USDC. Free to call. It never pays and never signs anything. Paying is done by an x402 client against the listed route.
